  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title

        - timestamp

When an owner is created via `POST /api/owners`, the application now counts how many other owners already share that owner's last name and returns it as the integer field `namesakeCount` in the owner response.

I followed the existing pattern already used for the other creation-time computed fields (`membershipNumber`, `customerCode`, `membershipTier`):

- **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — computes `countNamesakes(lastName)` from the currently-registered owners (the new owner isn't persisted yet, so it's naturally excluded) via exact last-name match, and sets it before saving.
- **`OwnerRestControllerV1Tests`** — added `createOwnerReturnsNamesakeCount`, asserting the first owner with a given last name gets `0` and a second sharing it gets `1`.

Note: `namesakeCount` is computed as the count of *other* existing owners with the same last name at the moment of creation, using exact-equality matching (the plainest reading of "same last name"), consistent with how the sibling creation-time fields work.
